more_info.overview: Lecitin citrate is a historical label supplied with an acidity-regulator classification. A specific chemical or commercial preparation under this exact name was not confirmed in the reviewed sources. It should not be assumed to be ordinary lecithin or a particular citrate salt. The preparation's manufacture, typical food applications and intake assessment remain unconfirmed.
